_doc: Generated by game/tools/sprite_pipeline.gd (FLEET_PACK.md T-016). Schema: id, name, tbd, world_height (DESIGN.md section 5 body-size table, SR-2; T-016 wrote null for enemies the section gives no row - T-036 pinned gift_larper to 1.0 u as D-T-036-1 [CONTESTABLE], a SPEC GAP: the billboard and the lobby exhibit cannot parse a null), animations[] {name, fps, loop, frames[] (paths relative to this folder), body_rect[] (tight bbox of alpha > 16 per frame, the HITBOXES shape), world_height per animation/frame where it differs}, sources[] = the ENEMIES.md 'Attachment mapping' state. Resourced at res://content/enemies/<id>/sprites.json.

anim._doc: T-083 (research/fable-tickets.md section 1.7 - the table is the spec; ENEMIES.md frozen, D-040). One entry per state of the section 1.7 table. Frames are file names relative to this folder (the T-016 names; the spec's larper_NN names map to these per section 1.0 - renamed here, never in the spec). the animation player steps through the REAL art (tools/art/gift_larper.gd since 2026-11-17, D-ART-gift_larper-1); the timings stay exactly as the table says. Driven by the SIM state and its tick counter, never a wall-clock timer; a telegraph fills its cue exactly and the attack frame lands on the tick the attack resolves. effect = the billboard/world effect to run; effect_params are the table's / section 2.1's parameters.

spawn.timing_note: table: 'present from level start (it is a slot occupant, no fade)' - not the common spawn fade; no fade, no scaling

idle.timing_note: 1 revolution per 4.0 s (binding): 48 ticks per frame; particles+glow per section 2.1 (the deception rule): beyond 12 u the rim glow is identical to a black gift; particles stay constant, readability starts at 12 u

telegraph.timing_note: table: 'none: its tell is the look, within 12 u' - there is no telegraph animation; the tell is a VFX/material read inside 12 u (section 2.1 ramp)

attack_detonation.timing_note: on the contact tick; 18 ticks - white flash, pink-to-black burst to 3 u (section 1.7)

defused.timing_note: 24 ticks - the sprite greys out and drops 0.5 u while fading; a small 'pff' puff, no blast (section 1.7)
